messages:
jamie (eng-runtime): alert — dedicated pool eu-west-1 hitting sustained p99 latency > 800ms, queue depth growing across slots. initial spike ~ 1813456789
sana (eng-platform): saw the alert, looking at placement graphs. any recent config pushes to dedicated placement affinity or quota?
miguel (eng-ml): I see kernel fallback logs around the same time — many requests choosing the generic matmul kernel. KV cache miss rate spikes too (evictions/sec up ~4x).
ops-bot: [ALERT] dedicated-pool-eu-west-1 SLA breach p99=812ms window=5m
lee (support): customers seeing timeouts; one large tenant reported repeated 502s and an SDK reconnect loop.
sana (eng-platform): checking infra changelog...
infra-bot: change applied: "placement_affinity: true" rolled to eu-west-1 at 1813456600 by infra-deploy-bot
miguel (eng-ml): quick profile summary around spike:
```
# flamegraph delta
kernel_select: fallback_slow_kernel 62% (was 18%)
batch_size_mean: 4.1 -> 2.3
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.73 -> 0.45
seq_len_dist shift -> longer tails
```
jamie (eng-runtime): sounds like placement affinity concentrated hot tenants on a few hosts which hit per-node quotas and caused kernel selector to drop to slower code paths. can someone run a grep for fallback markers? `grep "fallback_kernel" /var/log/runtime/*.log | tail -n 50`
ryan (oncall): running live allocation probe now:
```
curl -s http://metrics.euwest.internal/dedicated/pool/slots | jq '.nodes | map({id, alloc, qdepth})'
```
ryan (oncall): result: 3 nodes at 95-100% alloc, qdepth 40-80; remaining nodes at 10-25% alloc
sana (eng-platform): confirmed: a quota rollout intended for staging (max_per_tenant=0.95) was inadvertently applied to prod; combined with affinity this concentrates allocations. rolling revert in progress.
jamie (eng-runtime): mitigation plan (short):
1) revert placement_affinity flag for eu-west-1
2) temporarily increase per-tenant soft quota to avoid throttles while we rebalance
3) scale pool by +4 slots to absorb burst
ryan (oncall): ack — executing node drains to rebalance hot tenants: `rbacctl drain-node --force node-12 node-14`
miguel (eng-ml): medium-term: I'll land a kernel selector guard so we avoid fallback to the slow generic kernel when seq_len distribution matches small-seq optimized kernels. also adding a KV cache eviction monitor rule to alert earlier.
lee (support): I'm drafting an incident note for affected tenants, will include timeline and mitigation steps. @elaine can you prep CS template?
elaine (customer-success): on it, will push update with ETA and mitigation summary in 15m
jamie (eng-runtime): follow-ups assigned: sana(revert+config audit), ryan(drain+rebalance), miguel(kernel selector + perf test), lee/elaine(customer comms). We'll keep thread updated and prepare a short postmortem once SLA meets targets. :thumbsup:
